sources.title: About · SZL Holdings
sources.snippet: About What SZL Holdings is SZL Holdings builds governed-AI infrastructure with inspectable source, bounded decision logic, and linked evidence. Its Lean corpus has an explicitly mixed proof posture: locked formulas are identified separately from open sorry -tagged obligations, and Lambda remains a conjecture rather than a theorem.

sources.title: GitHub - szl-holdings/khipu-consensus: BFT 3-of-4 multi-party-witnessed ...
sources.snippet: The category SZL invents: multi-party-witnessed AI. Turn a chain of governance "organs" into a Byzantine-fault-tolerant multi-signature agreement. Each witness signs an action hash with its own ECDSA-P256 key. ≥ 3 valid allow signatures over the same action ⇒ canonical. 2-of-4 or fewer ⇒ rejected. This is the open-source reference for the consensus protocol that powers SZL Holdings ...
